# Momentum 3.0.0

> Canonical API quick-reference for `momentum` `3.0.0` — an MVC state management, dependency injection, service locator, persistence, time-travel (undo/redo), event bus, and persistent routing library for Flutter (Dart `>=3.0.0 <4.0.0`, Flutter `>=3.50.0`).

Install with `material_ui` (which replaces deprecated `package:flutter/material.dart` in Flutter 3.47+):

```yaml
dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter
  material_ui: ^1.11.1
  momentum: ^3.0.0
```

Single public import:

```dart
import 'package:momentum/momentum.dart';
```

## Minimal Complete Example (3.0.0)

```dart
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:momentum/momentum.dart';

void main() => runApp(momentum());

Momentum momentum() => Momentum(
      controllers: [CounterController()],
      child: const MyApp(),
    );

class MyApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const MyApp({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(
      theme: ThemeData(colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSeed(seedColor: Colors.blue)),
      home: const HomeWidget(),
    );
  }
}

class CounterModel extends MomentumModel<CounterController> {
  const CounterModel(super.controller, {required this.value});
  final int value;

  @override
  void update({int? value}) {
    CounterModel(controller, value: value ?? this.value).updateMomentum();
  }
}

class CounterController extends MomentumController<CounterModel> {
  @override
  CounterModel init() => CounterModel(this, value: 0);

  void increment() => model.update(value: model.value + 1);
}

class HomeWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  const HomeWidget({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Momentum Counter')),
      body: Center(
        child: MomentumBuilder(
          controllers: const [CounterController],
          builder: (context, snapshot) {
            final counter = snapshot<CounterModel>();
            return Text('${counter.value}', style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineMedium);
          },
        ),
      ),
      floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton(
        onPressed: Momentum.controller<CounterController>(context).increment,
        tooltip: 'Increment',
        child: const Icon(Icons.add),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

## Public API Quick-Reference (`package:momentum/momentum.dart`)

### `Momentum` (Root `InheritedWidget`)

```dart
Momentum({
  Key? key,
  Future<void> Function()? initializer,
  Widget? child,                              // required at runtime; optional for MomentumTester
  Widget? appLoader,                          // shown during async startup; defaults to centered spinner
  required List<MomentumController> controllers,
  List<MomentumService>? services,
  ResetAll? onResetAll,                       // (BuildContext, void Function(BuildContext) resetAll)
  bool? disabledPersistentState,              // default: false
  bool? enableLogging,                        // default: false
  int? maxTimeTravelSteps,                    // default: 1 (clamped 1..250; >1 enables undo/redo)
  bool? lazy,                                 // default: true
  int? minimumBootstrapTime,                  // default: 0 (milliseconds)
  BootstrapStrategy? strategy,                // default: BootstrapStrategy.lazyFirstBuild
  PersistSaver? persistSave,                  // Future<bool> Function(BuildContext?, String key, String? value)
  PersistGet? persistGet,                     // Future<String?> Function(BuildContext?, String key)
  void Function()? restartCallback,
})
```

Static methods:
- `Momentum.controller<T extends MomentumController>(BuildContext context) -> T` (safe in `initState()` and `build()`; does not subscribe widget to rebuilds)
- `Momentum.service<T extends MomentumService>(BuildContext context, {bool runtimeType = true, dynamic alias}) -> T`
- `Momentum.resetAll(BuildContext context, {bool? clearHistory}) -> void`
- `Momentum.restart(BuildContext context, [Momentum? momentum]) -> void` (uses `restartCallback` if configured; otherwise replaces navigation stack with `momentum`; throws `MomentumError` if both are null)

### `BootstrapStrategy` (Enum)
- `BootstrapStrategy.lazyFirstBuild` *(default)* — bootstraps lazy controllers on first `MomentumBuilder` mount.
- `BootstrapStrategy.lazyFirstCall` — bootstraps lazy controllers on first `Momentum.controller<T>(context)` call.

### `MomentumModel<Controller extends MomentumController>` (`@immutable abstract`)
- Constructor: `const MomentumModel(this.controller)`
- Properties: `final Controller controller`, `String get controllerName`
- Required override: `void update(...)` — instantiate a copy with `controller` and call `.updateMomentum()`.
- Protected helper: `void updateMomentum()` — commits the new model to `controller` (no-op if `newModel == currentModel`, compatible with `equatable`).
- Optional persistence overrides:
  - `Map<String, dynamic>? toJson() => null`
  - `MomentumModel? fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>? json) => null` *(instance method, NOT a factory, so it can pass `controller`)*

### `MomentumController<M extends MomentumModel<dynamic>>` (`abstract`)
- Required override: `@protected M init()`
- Lifecycle hooks (execution order on startup):
  1. `Momentum.initializer()` *(awaited)*
  2. Services initialized (`MomentumRouter.init()` awaited)
  3. All controllers: `init()` + restore persisted model
  4. Non-lazy controllers (`lazy == false`): `bootstrap()`
  5. Non-lazy controllers: `bootstrapAsync()` *(awaited in parallel via `Future.wait`)*
  6. All controllers: `onReady()`
- Per-controller config (cascade once in `Momentum(controllers: [...])`):
  `controller..config(enableLogging: ..., maxTimeTravelSteps: ..., lazy: ..., strategy: ...)`
- State & time travel:
  - `M get model`
  - `M? get prevModel` / `M? get nextModel` *(non-null only when `maxTimeTravelSteps > 1`)*
  - `void backward()` *(undo)* / `void forward()` *(redo)*
  - `void reset({bool? clearHistory})`
  - `void clearStateHistory()`
- Dependency injection (no `BuildContext` required):
  - `T controller<T extends MomentumController>()` *(cannot reference itself)*
  - `T service<T extends MomentumService>({bool runtimeType = true, dynamic alias})`
- Events & listeners (register inside `MomentumState.initMomentumState()`):
  - `void sendEvent<T>(T data)`
  - `void listen<T>({required MomentumState state, required void Function(T data) invoke})`
  - `void addListener({required MomentumState state, required void Function(M model, bool isTimeTravel) invoke})`
- Persistence & metadata:
  - `Future<bool?> skipPersist() async => null` *(overrides global `disabledPersistentState` when non-null)*
  - `String get persistenceKey` *(overridable)*
  - `bool? get persistentStateDisabled`, `bool? get loggingEnabled`, `int? get maxTimeTravelSteps`, `bool? get isLazy`, `BootstrapStrategy? get strategy`

### `MomentumBuilder` (`StatefulWidget`)

```dart
MomentumBuilder(
  key: key,
  owner: this,                        // optional Widget for clearer error logs (`this` or `widget`)
  controllers: const [MyController],  // List<Type>?; rebuilds when any listed controller updates
  dontRebuildIf: (controller, isTimeTravel) {
    final c = controller<MyController>();
    return false;                     // return true to skip rebuild
  },
  builder: (context, snapshot) {
    final model = snapshot<MyModel>();
    // Disambiguate when multiple controllers share a model type:
    // final model = snapshot<SharedModel>(SpecificController);
    return Text('${model.value}');
  },
)
```

### `MomentumState<T extends StatefulWidget>` (`abstract extends State<T>`)
- Override `@override void initMomentumState()` — called once in `didChangeDependencies()` before `build()`, safe for `Momentum.controller<T>(context)` and registering `listen<E>(state: this, ...)` / `addListener(state: this, ...)`.
- Automatically cancels all event subscriptions and removes listeners in `dispose()`.
- Property: `bool get deactivated`.

### `MomentumService` & `InjectService<S extends MomentumService>`
- Extend `MomentumService` and register in `Momentum(services: [...])`.
- Inside a service, resolve sibling services with `service<OtherService>({bool runtimeType = true, dynamic alias})`.
- Resolve an implementation via an abstract base class using `runtimeType: false`:
  `service<AuthRepository>(runtimeType: false)` / `Momentum.service<AuthRepository>(context, runtimeType: false)`.
- Register multiple instances of the same service type with `InjectService`:
  ```dart
  services: [
    InjectService<ApiService>(ApiAlias.prod, ApiService('https://api.example.com')),
    InjectService<ApiService>(ApiAlias.staging, ApiService('https://staging.example.com')),
  ]
  // Lookup:
  final api = service<ApiService>(alias: ApiAlias.prod);
  // Or retrieve wrapper:
  final injected = Momentum.service<InjectService<ApiService>>(context, alias: ApiAlias.prod);
  final raw = injected.value;
  ```

### Routing: `MomentumRouter`, `RouterPage`, `RouterParam`, `RouterMixin`
- Register `MomentumRouter([HomePage(), DetailsPage()], enablePersistence: true)` in `Momentum(services: [...])`.
- Set `MaterialApp(home: MomentumRouter.getActivePage(context))`.
- Wrap screens in `RouterPage(child: Scaffold(...), onWillPop: ...)` (uses `PopScope` for system back navigation).
- Static methods:
  - `MomentumRouter.goto(context, DetailsPage, params: DetailsParam(...), transition: ...)`
  - `MomentumRouter.pop(context, result: ..., transition: ...)`
  - `MomentumRouter.getParam<DetailsParam>(context)` → `DetailsParam?`
  - `MomentumRouter.getActivePage(context)` → `Widget`
  - `MomentumRouter.clearHistoryWithContext(context)` → `Future<void>`
  - `MomentumRouter.resetWithContext<HomePage>(context)` → `Future<void>`
- Instance methods/getters on `MomentumRouter`: `getActive()`, `getCurrentParam<T>()`, `clearHistory()`, `reset<T>()`, `isRoutesEmpty`, `exited`, `mockParam(RouterParam)`.
- Extend `@immutable abstract class RouterParam {}` for typed route payloads.
- Add `with RouterMixin` to a `MomentumController` for `T? getParam<T extends RouterParam>()` and `@override void onRouteChanged(RouterParam? param)`.

### Testing: `MomentumTester`
- Headless unit testing without pumping widgets:
  ```dart
  final tester = MomentumTester(
    Momentum(
      controllers: [CounterController()],
      services: [ApiService()],
    ),
  );
  await tester.init();
  final ctrl = tester.controller<CounterController>()!;
  final api = tester.service<ApiService>();
  await tester.mockLazyBootstrap<CounterController>();
  tester.mockRouterParam(DetailsParam(id: '1'));
  ```

### Errors & Exported Typedefs
- `MomentumError(String? cause)` — thrown for missing/duplicate controllers, services, ancestors, or invalid restart config.
- `MomentumSnapshot = T Function<T>([Type])`
- `MomentumBuilderFunction = Widget Function(BuildContext, MomentumSnapshot)`
- `ResetAll = void Function(BuildContext, void Function(BuildContext) resetAll)`
- `BuildSkipper = bool Function(T Function<T extends MomentumController>(), bool isTimeTravel)`
- `PersistSaver = Future<bool> Function(BuildContext? context, String key, String? value)`
- `PersistGet = Future<String?> Function(BuildContext? context, String key)`

## Breaking Changes & Removed APIs (Do Not Use in 3.0.0)

| Removed / Legacy | 3.0.0 Replacement |
| --- | --- |
| `Momentum.of<T>(context)` | `Momentum.controller<T>(context)` |
| `Momentum.getService<T>(context)` | `Momentum.service<T>(context)` |
| `dependOn<T>()` (in controller) | `controller<T>()` |
| `getService<T>()` (in controller/service) | `service<T>()` |
| `Router` (removed in 2.0.0) | `MomentumRouter` |
| `package:flutter/material.dart` | `package:material_ui/material_ui.dart` |
| `WillPopScope` | `PopScope` (`onPopInvokedWithResult`) / `RouterPage` |
| `Theme.of(context).textTheme.headline4` | `Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineMedium` |
